name: BlobCursor-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The purple blob is near the pointer and fully in frame, showing its stretched shape.

tagline: A soft purple blob trails the pointer and stretches to catch up.
summary: A round violet shape chases the mouse across a dark panel, flexing into a teardrop as it moves, with fainter copies lagging behind it.
appearance: A violet disc with a small white dot at its centre glides over a near-black panel, its edges blurred into a soft cloud. When it moves it stretches into an egg shape, and dimmer copies trail it.
behaviour: Each pointer move tweens three discs toward the cursor at different speeds, so the largest lags and the smallest leads. When the pointer stops they settle back into round blobs.
demo_content: Heading "Move your cursor" with the caption "The blob follows your mouse".
search_phrases: purple blob that follows the mouse
custom pointer for a landing page
elastic shape that chases the cursor
use_when: A playful portfolio or marketing page wants a custom pointer with personality.
avoid_when: The blob slides over nearby text, and being pointer-only it does nothing for keyboard or reduced-motion users.
customise: Blob shape, fill, inner dot colour and size, trail count, sizes, opacities, shadow and blur filter are all props. There is no content to pass in.
weight_why: Three plain divs tweened by GSAP, with one SVG blur filter laid over them.

a11y.note: Purely decorative pointer movement; the trail cannot be reached from the keyboard and ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The blob passes over the centre heading and hides it in frame 3.
There is no reduced-motion path; the follower keeps chasing for users who asked it not to.
polish_why: Smooth tactile lag and a soft edge; the blob sitting on top of copy is the weak spot.
